ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the channel endpoint. When it matches a stored channel endpoint, that channel endpoint is updated. Otherwise a new channel endpoint is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

AddressType.description: Kind of address: 'PhoneNumber' or 'EmailAddress'. When empty, it is taken from 'Channel'.

Capabilities.description: What the address is used for, named by channel, for example ['Phone', 'SMS'] for a number used for calls and texts.

MergedItemIds.description: Identifiers of records merged into this address; history that names them finds this address.

Channel.description: Single channel of an address exported before addresses had capabilities, for example 'SMS' or 'Phone'. Read only when 'AddressType' and 'Capabilities' are absent.

Value.description: Address of the endpoint on the channel, for example a phone number or email address.

Description.description: Administrative description of the channel endpoint.

ProviderName.description: Technical name of the messaging or telephony provider that owns this address (for example 'Twilio', 'Telnyx' or 'AzureCommunicationServices'). When empty, the tenant-default provider is used.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the channel endpoint, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

ChannelEndpoints.description: Channel endpoints to create or update.
